isolated_chroot_script:
set -eu
export CORPUS_ROOT=/corpus/0033 CORPUS_RUN=/scratch/apache APACHE_MODULE_DIR=/usr/lib/apache2
mkdir -p "$CORPUS_RUN"
httpd -v
httpd -t -f "$CORPUS_ROOT/httpd.conf"
httpd -f "$CORPUS_ROOT/httpd.conf" -k start
trap 'httpd -f "$CORPUS_ROOT/httpd.conf" -k stop' EXIT
curl --retry 5 --retry-delay 1 --retry-connrefused --fail --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:18033/hello.txt -o "$CORPUS_RUN/response.txt"
cmp "$CORPUS_ROOT/www/hello.txt" "$CORPUS_RUN/response.txt"
cat "$CORPUS_RUN/response.txt"
printf '%s\n' 'PASS: Apache parser accepted configuration; HTTP 200 body exactly matches source.'
isolated_host_setup_script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
rootfs="$1"
mounted_here=0
if ! mountpoint -q "$rootfs/dev"; then
  mount --bind /dev "$rootfs/dev"
  mounted_here=1
fi
cleanup() { if [ "$mounted_here" = 1 ]; then umount "$rootfs/dev"; fi; }
trap cleanup EXIT
timeout 60 chroot "$rootfs" /bin/sh /corpus/verify_33.sh

functional_validation.http_check: curl --fail accepted response and cmp verified every body byte against www/hello.txt
functional_validation.evidence_marker: PASS emitted after curl and cmp in the set -eu chroot script
functional_validation.cleanup_warning: The outer wrapper failed to unmount its /dev bind mount after server stop. This occurred after the native syntax and HTTP assertions passed.

cleanup_script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
rootfs=$1
expected=$2
test "$(realpath "$rootfs")" = "$expected"
case "$rootfs" in */work/tools_27_33/alpine) ;; *) printf '%s\n' 'Unexpected rootfs path.' >&2; exit 1;; esac
mount_target="$rootfs/dev"
printf 'Cleanup target: %s\n' "$mount_target"

apache_pids() {
    for proc in /proc/[0-9]*; do
        [ "$(readlink "$proc/root" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$expected" ] || continue
        executable=$(readlink "$proc/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
        case "$executable" in "$expected/usr/sbin/httpd")
            arguments=$(tr '\000' ' ' < "$proc/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)
            case "$arguments" in *'/corpus/0033/httpd.conf'*) printf '%s\n' "${proc##*/}";; esac
            ;;
        esac
    done
}

pids=$(apache_pids)
if [ -n "$pids" ]; then
    printf 'Matching corpus Apache PIDs before cleanup: %s\n' "$pids"
    for pid in $pids; do
        [ "$(readlink "/proc/$pid/root" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$expected" ] || continue
        [ "$(readlink "/proc/$pid/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$expected/usr/sbin/httpd" ] || continue
        kill -TERM "$pid"
    done
fi
remaining=$(apache_pids)
count=0
while [ -n "$remaining" ] && [ "$count" -lt 20 ]; do
    sleep 1
    count=$((count+1))
    remaining=$(apache_pids)
done
if [ -n "$remaining" ]; then
    printf 'Corpus Apache PIDs still present: %s\n' "$remaining" >&2
    exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' 'PASS: no Apache process belongs to this corpus rootfs/configuration.'

if mountpoint -q "$mount_target"; then
    findmnt --mountpoint "$mount_target" --noheadings --output TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE
    if umount "$mount_target"; then
        printf '%s\n' 'Unmount completed normally.'
    else
        # This exact mount belongs to the temporary rootfs of this corpus.
        # Detach it without touching /dev itself or terminating other processes.
        umount -l "$mount_target"
        printf '%s\n' 'The exact temporary /dev bind mount was lazily detached after normal unmount reported busy.'
    fi
fi
if mountpoint -q "$mount_target"; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Temporary bind mount is still active.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' 'PASS: temporary /dev bind mount is no longer active.'
